provenance_note: All client/vendor/human/contact data excluded. Retail mixed-use vertical retained; tenant copy excluded.

program_model.instance_model: one monument assembly of stacked sub-cabinets (anchor tenant + center ID + tenant directory + topper)

knowledge.plain_language_summary: A tall stacked-cabinet monument that reads as a low pylon: an anchor-tenant cabinet with pan-formed polycarbonate faces, a center landlord ID cabinet with premium push-thru acrylic copy, a lit decorative topper, and a tenant directory cabinet with divider bars, all pole-mounted on twin steel pipes.
knowledge.rationale: Mixing cost-effective pan-formed poly faces for the national anchor brand with push-thru acrylic on the landlord ID balances brand reproduction against premium identity; stacked cabinets let each tenant zone be built and serviced separately.

structure.construction: double-sided 24in deep aluminum angle frame + .090in skin + 2in retainers, pan-formed 0.150in clear polycarbonate faces backsprayed blockout black + translucent color, saddle-mounted, painted P1
double-sided 24in deep, .090in skin with 1/8in removable faces, routed push-thru 3/4in translucent white acrylic copy with 1/8in milled flanges, painted P2/P3
aluminum angle frame, removable .090in top, 3/16in translucent white acrylic faces on 3 sides, 2x2in accent bars painted P2, lit
double-sided 24in deep with 2in retainers, T-bar dividers + 2in extruded aluminum divider bars, 3/16in translucent white acrylic faces, painted P3
twin 5in dia Sch40 steel pipes 16ft (5ft in footing, 11ft above grade) painted black; aluminum base frame + skin + square-tube accent cap

materials_manifest.product: Matthews T/M SW6144 Enduring Bronze satin
Matthews T/M SW7055 Dapper Tan satin

rules_observations: Clear hierarchy: anchor + landlord ID dominate, tenant panels uniform/subordinate.
craft_observations: Pan-formed poly anchor faces vs push-thru acrylic landlord ID is a deliberate cost/quality split.
SW-matched bronze/tan earth palette for site-fit; external disconnect + Class II supplies for service.

modeling_notes: Pole-mounted multi-cabinet monument borders pylon; tagged monument per drawing title.
